terrainDescription.zh: 阿爾卑斯山脈占據南部與中部，中央高原（Mittelland）為主要農業與人口聚居帶，北部與東部另有汝拉山脈與森林地形。
terrainDescription.en: The Alps dominate the south and center; the Swiss Plateau (Mittelland) is the main agricultural and population belt, with the Jura mountains and forest in the north/east.

plate.color: white background, black text; rear plate also shows the Swiss coat of arms and the canton's coat of arms
plate.shape: front 300×80mm, rear 300×160mm or 500×110mm; format AB·123456 (2-letter canton code + up to 6 digits)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Black-and-white, curved-cylindrical bollards, highly standardized nationally — community GeoGuessr sources rate Swiss bollards as one of the most reliable clues (95%+ accuracy when visible)

utilityPole.transformerMount: Round wooden poles are the most common type

historicalContext.zh: 瑞士有四種官方語言（德語約62%、法語約23%、義大利語約8%、羅曼什語不到1%但仍為官方語言），語言分界線清楚劃分不同區域，跨越邊界時路牌語言會隨之改變，是絕佳的教學案例；瑞士並非歐盟成員國。
historicalContext.en: Switzerland has four official languages (German ~62%, French ~23%, Italian ~8%, Romansh under 1% but still official), with clear linguistic-region boundaries — road-sign language visibly changes as you cross them, making it a great teaching case. Switzerland is not an EU member.
